schema.np: prefill rows, i.e. rows whose extend length is > 1
schema.ptok: new tokens across those prefill rows
schema.pf: cached prefix behind those prefill rows, summed
schema.nd: decode rows, i.e. rows whose extend length is 1 (a mixed batch carries decode rows this way)
schema.dkv: KV behind the decode rows, summed
schema.gpu_ms_<arm>: that step's own GPU span, from CUDA events read one step later so nothing synchronises on the hot path
schema.shapes_agree: true when every arm presented identical shapes for this step index, so the per-arm times are comparable

row_reconstruction: Per-row shapes are not logged individually. For kernel replay, a step is np prefill rows and nd decode rows: give one prefill row mx tokens with prefix pf/np and the rest (ptok - mx)/(np - 1) each, and nd decode rows of 1 token with dkv/nd KV. The medians of this reconstruction are the shapes used by row_cmp.py and attn_share.py.
